description: Fimbul.jl is a Julia toolbox from SINTEF for geothermal reservoir simulation. It builds on JutulDarcy.jl and includes an example geothermal doublet that users can run with a reservoir case and plotting package. Inputs are subsurface geometry, rock and fluid properties, well configuration and operating conditions. Outputs are simulated reservoir states, including temperature around production and injection wells, for the selected domain and run period. Geographic coverage and spatial resolution come from a user's reservoir grid. The source is free under MIT terms, with online documentation and an installable Julia package. A limitation is that the sample doublet is a demonstration, not a calibrated field assessment; site decisions need measured geology and validation. Fimbul can support geothermal district-heating supply and subsurface capacity studies. The catalogue's model-openfoam is a separate general flow simulator, not a Fimbul dependency. No reservoir case was run.
name: Fimbul.jl geothermal reservoir simulator
